seo.description: Complete guide to Business Management in France for Indian students: Top French universities, admission requirements, tuition fees (€255 – €3,950 / year public), scholarships, and 2-year post-study work visa.

sections.title: 1. Is France a good country for studying Business Management?

items: In France, you will find a range of public universities and business schools offering programs in general management, international business, finance, marketing and entrepreneurship. Applicants should compare the curriculum, cost, qualification status and careers services before choosing a program.

sections.title: 2. The cost of Business Management in France is?

items: For 2026-2027, the regular registration cost for a master’s program at a public institution is €255 per year for EU/EEA/Swiss students and €3,950 for non-EU students, subject to differentiated fees. Private business schools and some specialist programs charge different fees, often higher.

sections.title: 3. Do you need work experience to get a Master’s in Business Management?

items: Not necessarily. Many MiM programs for those without previous experience will accept recent graduates with little or no full-time work experience. Most MBA and executive programs usually require students to have some professional experience, so be sure to check the specific requirements.

sections.title: 4. What jobs can I do after studying Business Management in France?

items: Career opportunities include Business Analyst, Marketing Executive, Project Coordinator, Consultant, Operations Specialist, Human Resources Professional and Business Development Executive. Career outcomes will vary depending on the student’s specialization, experience, language ability and work authorization.

Students should confirm the precise qualification awarded by the institution before accepting an offer. **Master in Management, MSc, MBA and master’s degree** do not automatically mean that each program has the same status in the French higher education system.
Students should verify:

* - If the institution and the particular program have the appropriate official recognition or accreditation.
* - Registration of the qualification in the French national framework of professional certification, where applicable.
* - whether the award is adequate for further education or employment in the country where the student intends to work

sections.title: 9. Business Management in France: Salary and Job Opportunities**

items: A **Business Management qualification in France** will equip graduates for a variety of positions in consulting, finance, marketing, retail, technology, manufacturing, hospitality and international trade.
Graduates can apply for positions like:
- Business Development Executive
- Strategy or Management Consultant.
- Marketing Executive or Brand Manager.
- Project Manager or Project Coordinator.
- Operational Manager.
- Human Resources Specialist.
- Business Analyst.
- Account Executive.
- Logistics or supply chain coordinator.
- Business Owner/Entrepreneur.
**Expected Salary**
The salary of Business Management graduates in France is not set.
Earnings are dependent on role, employer, location, degree, experience, language skills and sector.
Entry-level jobs in business typically don’t require specialized skills or prior experience like consulting, finance and management jobs do.
Exact document checklist will depend on institution and program.
Commonly requested documents are:
- Accepted identity document or valid passport.
- Degree Certificate or Provisional Certificate for post graduate applications.
- Academic history, including transcripts and grades.
- Abstract.
- Statement of Purpose (SOP) or Letter of Motivation
- Test results in English or French if required.
- Letters of recommendation, as appropriate.
- Scores of GMAT, GRE or other entrance tests, if applicable.
- Proof of work experience for MBA or executive programs where applicable.
- Certified translations of documents not accepted in the original language.
- Application form duly filled and the application fee, if applicable.
- Any other documents requested by the institution or by the visa authorities.
If you are still working on your degree, you may be asked to submit current transcripts and proof of expected graduation.
Students are always advised to follow the institution's instructions for the format, certification and submission of documents.
